task.description:
The 7 legacy placeholder records were moved by a one-off script on 2026-10-30 (evidence in .gaugeblock/storypole/plans/JN-9.md). That was a recorded decision, not a tool: the next occurrence needs a repeatable, reviewed operation rather than an ad hoc python command, because editing an append-only telemetry log is exactly the kind of thing that should be a subcommand with a dry-run.

Scope: `joiner spool quarantine --dir <suite> [--dry-run]`, moving records whose filled_holes carry an empty body or the <filled> placeholder into .gaugeblock/spool/quarantine/<reason>-<date>.jsonl, printing count and hash, never deleting. Idempotent. Note the spool is gitignored, so the tool should also write a one-line summary somewhere tracked (ledger via storypole, or a sibling .md) or the event leaves no versioned trace.
task.title: joiner spool quarantine: move unusable records out of the outbox repeatably
